<span style="color: rgb(36, 36, 36); font-family: source-serif-pro, Georgia, Cambria, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 20px; letter-spacing: -0.06px;">I recently caught up with&nbsp;</span><a class="ag lz" href="https://www.linkedin.com/in/inonsharony/" rel="noopener ugc nofollow" target="_blank" style="box-sizing: inherit; -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent; font-family: source-serif-pro, Georgia, Cambria, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 20px; letter-spacing: -0.06px;">Inon Sharony</a><span style="color: rgb(36, 36, 36); font-family: source-serif-pro, Georgia, Cambria, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 20px; letter-spacing: -0.06px;">, the Head of AI at ASTERRA, to learn about the fascinating world of machine learning with SAR imagery, and you can view the full conversation below. Inspired by that conversation, this post covers some of the applications that utilise SAR, provides a short introduction to the essential considerations when using deep learning approaches with SAR data, identifies emerging trends in this area and provides resources for getting hands on with SAR &amp; deep learning.</span><div><span style="color: rgb(36, 36, 36); font-family: source-serif-pro, Georgia, Cambria, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 20px; letter-spacing: -0.06px;"><br></span></div><div><h1 id="c995" class="nh ni fs bf nj nk nl nm nn no np nq nr ns nt nu nv nw nx ny nz oa ob oc od oe bk" data-selectable-paragraph="" style="box-sizing: inherit; margin: 1.95em 0px -0.28em; font-family: sohne, &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; color: rgb(36, 36, 36); line-height: 30px; letter-spacing: -0.016em; font-size: 24px;">A very brief introduction to SAR ?</h1></div><div><br></div><div><a class="ag lz" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Synthetic-aperture_radar" rel="noopener ugc nofollow" target="_blank" style="box-sizing: inherit; -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent; font-family: source-serif-pro, Georgia, Cambria, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 20px; letter-spacing: -0.06px;">Synthetic Aperture Radar</a><span style="color: rgb(36, 36, 36); font-family: source-serif-pro, Georgia, Cambria, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 20px; letter-spacing: -0.06px;">&nbsp;(SAR) systems use the reflection of radar signals, rather than light, to construct images. This provides SAR with the capacity for all-weather operation and the ability to capture imagery during both day and night conditions.</span></div><div><span style="color: rgb(36, 36, 36); font-family: source-serif-pro, Georgia, Cambria, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 20px; letter-spacing: -0.06px;"><br></span></div><div><img src="data:image/png;base64," alt=""><span style="color: rgb(36, 36, 36); font-family: source-serif-pro, Georgia, Cambria, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 20px; letter-spacing: -0.06px;"></span></div><div><br></div><div><span style="color: rgb(36, 36, 36); font-family: source-serif-pro, Georgia, Cambria, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 20px; letter-spacing: -0.06px;">Beyond image acquisition, the polarimetry and phase information contained within SAR data enables polarimetric SAR (PolSAR) and&nbsp;</span><a class="ag lz" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Interferometric_synthetic-aperture_radar" rel="noopener ugc nofollow" target="_blank" style="box-sizing: inherit; -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent; font-family: source-serif-pro, Georgia, Cambria, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 20px; letter-spacing: -0.06px;">interferometric SAR</a><span style="color: rgb(36, 36, 36); font-family: source-serif-pro, Georgia, Cambria, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 20px; letter-spacing: -0.06px;">&nbsp;(InSAR). PolSAR is a technique that provides detailed information about the physical properties under the Earth’s surface, whilst InSAR can measure small displacements in the Earth’s surface.</span></div><div><span style="color: rgb(36, 36, 36); font-family: source-serif-pro, Georgia, Cambria, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 20px; letter-spacing: -0.06px;"><br></span></div><div><span style="color: rgb(36, 36, 36); font-family: source-serif-pro, Georgia, Cambria, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 20px; letter-spacing: -0.06px;">The underlying physics of SAR and its contrast to optical imaging is a detailed topic, and to learn more I recommend viewing the Minds Behind Maps episode below (</span><a class="ag lz" href="https://www.mindsbehindmaps.com/episode/thomas-ager-the-essentials-of-sar-synthetic-aperture-radar-mbm60" rel="noopener ugc nofollow" target="_blank" style="box-sizing: inherit; -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent; font-family: source-serif-pro, Georgia, Cambria, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 20px; letter-spacing: -0.06px;">also available as an audio podcast</a><span style="color: rgb(36, 36, 36); font-family: source-serif-pro, Georgia, Cambria, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 20px; letter-spacing: -0.06px;">):</span><span style="color: rgb(36, 36, 36); font-family: source-serif-pro, Georgia, Cambria, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 20px; letter-spacing: -0.06px;"></span></div><div><span style="color: rgb(36, 36, 36); font-family: source-serif-pro, Georgia, Cambria, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 20px; letter-spacing: -0.06px;"><br></span></div><div><h1 id="5c86" class="nh ni fs bf nj nk nl nm nn no np nq nr ns nt nu nv nw nx ny nz oa ob oc od oe bk" data-selectable-paragraph="" style="box-sizing: inherit; margin: 1.95em 0px -0.28em; font-family: sohne, &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; color: rgb(36, 36, 36); line-height: 30px; letter-spacing: -0.016em; font-size: 24px;">Monitoring with SAR</h1></div><div><br></div><div><span style="color: rgb(36, 36, 36); font-family: source-serif-pro, Georgia, Cambria, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 20px; letter-spacing: -0.06px;">The utilisation of SAR for routine monitoring tasks is extensive, and SAR may be used alone, or to augment optical imagery by providing additional information such as soil moisture levels.</span></div><div><h2 id="3032" class="ox ni fs bf nj oy oz pa nn pb pc pd nr ml pe pf pg mp ph pi pj mt pk pl pm pn bk" data-selectable-paragraph="" style="box-sizing: inherit; margin: 1.72em 0px -0.31em; font-family: sohne, &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; color: rgb(36, 36, 36); line-height: 24px; font-size: 20px; text-align: start;">Underground monitoring of critical civil infrastructures</h2><p id="e6ee" class="pw-post-body-paragraph ma mb fs mc b md of mf mg mh og mj mk ml oh mn mo mp oi mr ms mt oj mv mw mx fl bk" data-selectable-paragraph="" style="box-sizing: inherit; margin: 0.94em 0px -0.46em; color: rgb(36, 36, 36); word-break: break-word; line-height: 32px; letter-spacing: -0.003em; font-family: source-serif-pro, Georgia, Cambria, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 20px;">PolSAR is sensitive to changes in moisture up to 3m deep. This enables the detection of changes even before their effects become visible at the Earth’s surface.&nbsp;<span class="mc ft" style="box-sizing: inherit; font-weight: 700;">This capability is utilised by ASTERRA in their EarthWorks solution</span>&nbsp;<span class="mc ft" style="box-sizing: inherit; font-weight: 700;">for</span>&nbsp;<span class="mc ft" style="box-sizing: inherit; font-weight: 700;">soil moisture monitoring and analysis in the presence of roads, railways, dams, levees, as seen&nbsp;</span><a class="ag lz" href="https://asterra.io/solutions/earthworks/" rel="noopener ugc nofollow" target="_blank" style="box-sizing: inherit; -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent;"><span class="mc ft" style="box-sizing: inherit; font-weight: 700;">on the ASTERRA website</span></a><span class="mc ft" style="box-sizing: inherit; font-weight: 700;">.&nbsp;</span>PolSAR also enables the early detection of underground leaks from water and wastewater.</p></div>
